stem: A high-stress training method improves canopy spread but delays recovery and reduces growth in one cultivar. What is the most defensible response?
choices: Adjust training intensity and timing using cultivar-specific recovery and canopy goals
Repeat the same intensity because training response is universal
Increase all inputs until recovery matches another cultivar
Ignore recovery because final height is the only outcome
rationale: Training response depends on genotype, environment, developmental stage and severity. Measured recovery and canopy goals should guide the method rather than a universal recipe.
